points.text: M1: benzylamine > ammonia > phenylamine
M1 M2: Any two for one mark, all three for two marks:
(basicity linked to) p orbital of N / lone pair on N AND being able to bond / accept / donate to / coordinate to a proton / $\text{H}^{+}$
(benzylamine) R / alkyl / $\text{CH}_{2}$ group AND is electron donating / positive inductive effect / has $+I$ effect
(phenylamine) p orbital of N / lone pair on N overlaps / incorporated / delocalised in the ring / $\pi$-bond system
M1: white ppt.
M2: structure of 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine as shown: benzene ring with $\text{NH}_{2}$ and Br atoms at 2,4,6-positions relative to $\text{NH}_{2}$
M1: lone pair / p-orbital / electrons on the nitrogen / $\text{NH}_{2}$ AND overlap / delocalised / incorporated AND with the ($\pi$-electrons) ring / $\pi$ system
M2: increasing its electron density (of the ring) OR it can polarise the electrophile / $\text{Br}_{2}$ better
lone pair / p-orbital on N is delocalised AND into $\text{C=O}$ group / across the two electronegative O and N
M1 M2: any two for one mark, all four for two marks:
lone pair on N
correct arrow from lone pair N to C (of $\text{C=O}$)
correct dipole on $\text{C=O}$ ($\text{C}^{\delta+}$ and $\text{O}^{\delta-}$)
correct arrow from the $\text{C=O}$ bond to O atom
M3: correct intermediate as shown: $\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{5}\text{C}(\text{O}^{-})(\text{NH}_{3}^{+})(\text{Cl})$
M4: arrow from $\text{O}^{-}$ to C–O bond AND arrow from C–Cl bond to Cl
points.guidance: ALLOW arrow from anywhere on O- to C-O bond
